input_identity: whole current part SHA + release_id/version/part_id + original member SHA/size, not filename-only
note_identity: exact original note path/case/bytes, with casefold conflict detection and separate factory-byte preservation
graph_identity: actual HTML/CSS/Markdown/catalog source-to-target/fragment parsed from restored native bytes; all paths case-sensitive
license: original synthetic release and notes; LICENSE.txt is a preserved release member
browser_boundary: Only authenticated original controlled reference assets were executed in a local-file author browser test. No arbitrary candidate code executed. Static consistency is not proof of candidate browser launch.
review_boundary: Models authored and independently calculated; not human expert review. No real Harness/Judge/finalize, L4/discrimination unmeasured.
target_identity: Resolve permitted relative/absolute/root-prefixed paths; compare actual restored SHA at the reported member/note target. Preserve verified/invalid/not_assessed distinctions in the rule-derived observation receipt. Static file inspection only.
independent_ownership: Original content loss: business; wrong placement of present original bytes: layout; fabricated alternate audit target: evidence. Artifact damage at its canonical target makes target provenance unknown/neutral rather than an automatic second loss.
